    """Encodes a value (possibly a numpy array or scalar) into a JSON-serializable structure.

    """
    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        return {

            "dtype": str(value.dtype),

        return {
            "__ndarray__": np.asarray(value).tolist(),

    """Reverses :func:`_serialize_value`, reconstructing numpy arrays with their dtype and shape."""
